findings.title: Metric alert handler is now uninstantiable
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` is abstract and requires implementations of `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. This `pass` subclass implements none of them, so accessing `detector.detector_handler` for a detector with this group type raises `TypeError` instead of returning a handler. Keep it on the concrete base or implement the required methods before registering it as a stateful handler.
